title: password strength meter
name: Password strength meter — Tidwell
rule: While a new password is typed, show a strength meter (and rules) so the user can see whether the value meets the system’s bar.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Password Strength Meter (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: During new-password entry, a meter and the rules are visible and update.
fail_when: New-password field has no meter and/or no rules while typing.
overview: Show a live strength meter and rules while a new password is typed.
apply_when: Creating or changing a password with system strength rules.
not_when: Login-only password fields that do not set a new password.
agent_hint: Show updating meter and rules during new-password entry.
description: While a new password is typed, show a strength meter and the rules so the user can see whether the value meets the system’s bar. Pass when meter and rules are visible and update during entry; fail when the new-password field has no meter and/or no rules while typing. Live feedback beats discovering rules only after a failed submit.
